proposals.minimum_observation: At least 100 eligible opportunities and 30 resolved attempts per observed chain, spanning at least 7 days, with 100% attempt-to-cost reconciliation; retain INSUFFICIENT DATA for smaller samples.
proposals.rationale: Promotion decisions should use one auditable money-weighted ledger containing actual Solana base/priority fees, EVM gas and builder payments, realised slippage/price impact, and fees burned by reverted, expired or otherwise failed attempts. Failure costs are EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE losses; adverse post-fill price movement is STRATEGY/MARKET loss.
proposals.shadow_test: In SHADOW, reconcile every attempted opportunity to an immutable cost record and independently recompute net P&L. Stop and fail the test if any known fee category is missing, totals differ beyond rounding tolerance, or a failed attempt with an on-chain/API cost contributes zero cost. Report strategy/market and execution/infrastructure P&L separately.

proposals.downside_risk: Additional quote traffic and selection bias if only successfully quoted assets are retained; all requests, failures and stale responses must be recorded.

proposals.expected_effect: Produces falsifiable Solana SHADOW observations using contemporaneous Jupiter entry and liquidation quotes, priority/base fees, rent effects where applicable, price impact, latency deterioration and sellability without creating orders.

proposals.expected_effect: Eliminates circular scoring from expected edge and exposes whether negative net P&L comes from the hypothesis or the implementation.

proposals.rationale: A current positive quote is an eligibility check, not an outcome. Durable evaluation requires pre-registered, forward, out-of-sample resolution and explicit attribution: adverse market movement or invalid signal is STRATEGY/MARKET; quote, RPC, simulation, submission, inclusion, reconciliation or exit-path malfunction is EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE.
proposals.shadow_test: Run immutable timestamped SHADOW cohorts by strategy and chain. Compare predicted net edge with later executable net outcome, including no-fill and failure costs. proposals.shadow_test: Replay each timestamped eligible route against subsequent block-state outcomes without submitting transactions. Fail the hypothesis if lower-bound money-weighted net expectancy is non-positive, failure-adjusted profit factor is at most 1, or quote-to-outcome coverage is below 95%.

rejected_ideas.idea: Promote any strategy because its current quote-simulated net total is positive.

rejected_ideas.idea: Restore or favour a strategy because a historical period had profitable trades.
rejected_ideas.reason: Historical leader or reference-period returns are subject to regime and selection bias and do not prove executable follower profitability after current costs.

rejected_ideas.idea: Increase trade frequency or relax edge, liquidity, sellability or simulation gates to obtain more samples.
rejected_ideas.reason: No trade is preferable to non-positive executable edge; sampling must not weaken safety or manufacture trades.

rejected_ideas.idea: Use a single pooled threshold or profitability result for Solana and all EVM chains.
rejected_ideas.reason: Priority fees, gas, builder payments, inclusion behavior, route atomicity, liquidity and failure modes are chain-specific.

summary: COPILOT_HANDOFF_ACK: 2026-08-21T21-52Z-copilot-protocol. Architecture correctly defaults to abstention and separates SHADOW research from LIVE execution, but its evaluation ledger does not yet prove durable money-weighted net profitability. Solana Strategy Lab inputs lack contemporaneous executable edge entirely. EVM inputs model chain-specific gas and builder costs, but quote simulations are not realised outcomes. Recorded Strategy Lab net profit can omit price impact, gas/priority fees and costs from failed attempts. Consequently no strategy is claimed profitable, CANARY-ready or LIVE-ready. Observed losses cannot presently be apportioned reliably between STRATEGY/MARKET loss and EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failure.
